summary: Birkenstock Holding plc files a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing of a €900 million 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033 offering by an indirect subsidiary. The filing primarily updates risk factors and business overview sections of its Form 20-F, covering DTC strategy, e-commerce risks, and regulatory matters. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is present. This is a routine debt offering disclosure with updated risk factors, not a special situation.
